_README: Ground truth for the table-anchored carve. Per cached filing, per target: either an
IDENTIFYING VALUE that must appear in the serialized TSV, or null meaning the target is
genuinely absent AS A TABLE from that filing.
Finding 'a table' is not the test. The research's naive header signature found tables and
picked the WRONG one 23 times out of 25 on audit fees, so every entry here pins a value
that only the correct table contains.
Provenance of each value is recorded in `_why`. The three director-comp values are the
strongest evidence in this file: the research measured all three as NULL in the old
edgartools path, and they were read off the filings by hand, so they were never produced
The audit-fee nulls are a measured FORMAT CLASS, not a shrug: EOG, GE, JPM and PEG all put
their fee CATEGORY LABELS in narrative prose. GE prints an unlabelled table
('2024 $ 17.9 $ 3.0 $ 0.0 $ 0.0 $ 20.9') and labels it in the following paragraph
('AUDIT FEES. Fees for the audit of...'); EOG, JPM and PEG give the figures in prose
('were $37.0 million and $26.3 million, respectively'). No table classifier can reach
these -- the router's narrative fallback owns them.
